bundle_inputs_model: bundle inputs into a PyTorch JIT ScriptModule for benchmarking and code coverage
augment_model_forward_inputs: augment a PyTorch model's forward method with bundled sample inputs
augment_model_multiple_functions: augment multiple PyTorch model functions with bundled sample inputs
inflate_tensor_argument: inflate a compressed tensor argument back to its original form in bundled inputs
bundle_randn_tensor: bundle a tensor that will be inflated with torch.randn at runtime
